caption:
Koko plays field hockey every weekend, and the back and hips feel stiff after every game.

Hockey means running bent over and twisting a lot to follow the ball. Folding at the hips with a steady trunk, rather than rounding from the back, can make that easier, and that takes trunk and hip strength. Try bridges (hold 3 seconds × 10), side planks on your knees (15 seconds × 3 each side) and slow knee rolls × 10, two to three times a week.

Pain spreading down a leg, sharp pain when twisting, or no change after two weeks are worth an assessment. Clinical Pilates at Hybrid Physio can help. Book online via the link in bio 🏑
